summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py: thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialised in __init__, set at the start of run_async and cleared in a finally around the whole body. The method checks not-running, then same-thread, then schedules a coroutine via run_coroutine_threadsafe that calls _set_active() and invoke(partial(callback, *args, **kwargs)), and returns future.result(). Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 8 tests (not-running before and after run, same-thread error, widget access, awaitable callable, timeout-class exception propagation, variadic/keyword forwarding, exit via method). All 8 pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src on the venv Python. Related existing tests: 25 passed, 9 failed, all 9 due to missing async test plugin in the venv (pre-existing environment limitation, not this change). Full suite and snapshot tests not run. Nothing committed.
